title: Kashmiri Pulao
subtitle: Saffron pilaf · Instant Pot · 3 adult servings + toddler
protein: ~9g protein per adult serving — pair with raita, dal or a paneer sabji

items.name: Boiled carrot or potato, finely diced (toddler only)

method.title: Prep & soak
items: Rinse {@rice} in several changes of water until mostly clear
Soak in fresh water for 30 min, then drain completely
Warm {@milk} for 20–30 sec; stir in {@saffron} and set aside
Coarsely crush {@fennel}
Dice the {@fruit}; refrigerate until serving

method.title: Fry nuts, then spices
items: Set Instant Pot to Sauté; heat {@ghee:nuts}
Fry {@cashews} until light golden, about 1 min
Add {@raisins}; fry 15–20 sec until plump
Remove both to a plate and set aside for garnish
Add {@ghee:spices}, then {@bay}, {@green-cardamom}, {@cloves}, {@cinnamon}, {@black-cardamom} and {@caraway}
Stir 20–30 sec until fragrant; don't let them darken
Add the crushed {@fennel}, {@ginger} and {@hing}; stir 10 sec

method.title: Roast rice & pressure cook
items: Add the drained {@rice}, {@salt}, {@sugar} and {@ghee:rice}
Fry gently 2–3 min until grains look dry and smell nutty
Pour in the saffron milk and {@water}; scrape the bottom clean
Taste the water — it should be lightly salty
Lock the lid, seal the valve, Pressure Cook on High {=5 min}
Natural release {=5–6 min}, then vent
Open and fluff gently with a fork

method.label: Toddler — scoop after fluffing, before garnish
items: Scoop about {½ cup} pulao into a small bowl before any garnish goes on
Pick out every whole spice: bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon
Optional: stir in {@carrot:toddler}
Top with {@cashews:toddler} crushed to coarse crumbs and chopped {@raisins:toddler}
Add finely diced {@fruit:toddler}
Let it cool to warm before serving

method.title: Garnish & serve
items: Transfer the adult pulao to a serving bowl
Top with the set-aside {@cashews:garnish} and {@raisins:garnish}
Scatter {@pomegranate} and {@fruit:garnish|diced apple and pineapple}
Serve warm; store leftover rice plain in the fridge and add fruit fresh to each serving
Reheat with a splash of water in the microwave

method.label: Tip
method.text: Water ratio assumes aged basmati in the Instant Pot; on the stovetop use 3 cups and cook covered on the lowest heat. Best with a pomegranate raita.
